title: CARE-3D: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence Grounded Agentic Reasoning in Situated 3D Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2611.29969v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Situated 3D reasoning requires embodied agents to interpret objects, scene geometry, and viewpoint dependent spatial relations. Existing methods learn grounded interactions from supervised traces, but largely imitate prescribed evidence acquisition patterns rather than optimizing the support that the returned evidence provides for the correct answer. Moreover, outcome rewards provide limited credit for intermediate tool choices and may leave infrequent tools underexplored. An effective agent should instead adaptively decide what to ground, which tool to invoke, and how to assess the utility of returned evidence. To this end, this paper presents CARE-3D, a reinforcement post-training framework for adaptive grounded reasoning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on grounding instructions first establishes valid interactions, after which Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) optimizes the agent while keeping the 3D grounding module frozen. CAR

translated_title: CARE-3D：面向情境化3D场景中基于证据的智能体推理的强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 情境化3D推理要求具身智能体能够理解物体、场景几何以及依赖视点的空间关系。现有方法从有监督的轨迹中学习有根据的交互，但在很大程度上是模仿预先规定的证据获取模式，而非优化所返回的证据对正确答案的支持程度。此外，基于结果的奖励对中间工具选择所提供的信用有限，可能导致不常用的工具探索不足。有效的智能体应当自适应地决定要对什么内容进行定位、调用哪个工具，以及如何评估所返回证据的效用。为此，本文提出了CARE-3D，一个用于自适应有根据推理的强化后训练框架。首先在定位指令上进行监督微调（SFT）以建立有效的交互，随后采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）对智能体进行优化，同时保持3D定位模块冻结。
tldr: CARE-3D提出了一种强化后训练框架，先通过监督微调建立有效的3D定位交互，再利用GRPO在冻结3D定位模块的同时优化智能体自适应地决定证据获取、工具调用与证据效用评估，从而提升情境化3D场景中基于证据的智能体推理能力。
en_tdlr: CARE-3D is a reinforcement post-training framework that first establishes valid interactions via supervised fine-tuning, then uses GRPO with a frozen 3D grounding module to enable agents to adaptively decide what to ground, which tools to invoke, and how to assess evidence utility for situated 3D reasoning.
